title: Recon manifest — the attack surface the system discovered in the target
description: Emitted by the threat-model run. Every element carries grounding evidence (a path/glob/string that must resolve in the target) so the eval can check faithfulness without an answer key.

description.description: optional free-text note about the system as a whole; null/omitted when not stated

detected_pattern.description: optional: the structural archetype recon observed (a neutral declared fact, not a score) — lets reliability analysis group runs by target shape. Use 'unknown' if ambiguous, or 'other' + detected_pattern_detail if it fits none

detected_pattern_detail.description: required by prose only when detected_pattern is 'other'; null/omitted otherwise

roles.description: distinct roles/principals the LLM identified (incl. anonymous/unauthenticated). Lets the RBAC-matrix precondition gate on a declared fact.

dataflows.description: OPTIONAL typed edges between declared elements — the structured-semantic-source spike (docs/research/visual-engine-2026-07/SEMANTIC-SOURCE-SPIKE.md). Every committed recon.json omits this and stays conformant. When present, the deterministic recon_to_d2.py render owns 100% of layout/aesthetics, and the edge checks become JSON reference/membership checks (checks.py::recon_semantic_checks) instead of regex over diagram text. source/destination are element ids (cross-reference integrity is a checks.py check, not expressible in JSON-Schema).

id.description: stable local id, e.g. C1 / D1 / E1 / TB1 / X1

type.description: OPTIONAL node-type token from the vocabulary catalog (references/node-type-icons.json) — primarily for components; the recon_to_d2.py render binds it to a shape/icon, and checks.py::recon_semantic_checks validates membership (fuzzy suggestion on a miss). Omitted/null on every committed recon; the render infers a per-array default when absent.

zone.description: OPTIONAL containment hint: the trust_boundary id (or parent boundary id) that encloses this element — the deterministic recon_to_d2.py render nests it inside that container. A trust_boundary whose zone points at another boundary nests inside it. Omitted/null on every committed recon (elements render at top level).

tech.description: optional technology/stack note for this element — a declared fact, not eval-inferred; null/omitted when not determinable

evidence.description: repo-relative path, glob, or literal source string that proves this element exists in the target

kind.description: trust_boundary only: the boundary class the LLM assigned (lets the eval reason about multi-zone chains without inferring it); 'unknown' or null/omitted when the sources don't reveal it — an honest absence the gate accepts, matching executor.md's absence rule

manifest.description: external_dep only: path to the dependency manifest/lockfile in evidence (enables the SBOM precondition); null/omitted when the dep has no manifest in the repo

risk.description: external_dep only: free-text risk note the LLM set (e.g. EOL, known-CVE) — a declared fact, not eval-inferred; null/omitted when none observed

source.description: id of the declared element/role the edge starts at (integrity checked in checks.py)

destination.description: id of the declared element/role the edge ends at (integrity checked in checks.py)

type.description: edge class — drives color/style in the deterministic render and replaces the diagram-text typed-prefix regex

protocol.description: optional wire protocol, e.g. HTTP / HTTPS / gRPC

sensitivity.description: optional data-sensitivity band carried on the edge label

enc.description: optional encryption-in-transit state carried on the edge label

label.description: optional short human description of the flow

evidence.description: optional repo-relative paths/strings that ground the flow (shape-checked, advisory, in checks.py)
